$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package testkit. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-ARM-ANYNAME
arms.note: arm lookup answers the first declared arm for every name, so an undeclared @:killer resolves and the build-time refusal is gone

arms.name: M-ARM-ROW-OK
arms.note: per-row validation reports nothing, so an arm declaring neither cut — or both — is accepted

arms.name: M-CLAIM-ALL-RECORDED
arms.note: every prose claim reads as already recorded by an annotation, so the census empties and the ratchet has nothing to compare

arms.name: M-CLAIM-CODE-BLIND
arms.note: the code senses of `control` stay in the text, so a rule's doc about control flow reads as a fixture claiming to be a control

arms.name: M-CLAIM-NEG-BLIND
arms.note: `NOT killed by` stays in the text, so the one fixture that says it has no arm reads as claiming one

arms.name: M-CLAIM-NOKINDS
arms.note: no doc comment claims anything, so the census is empty and every prose convention reads as already annotated

arms.name: M-CLAIM-RAW-DOC
arms.note: the doc keeps its gutter and line breaks, so a claim wrapped across two lines is invisible — the failure mode of a line-oriented search

arms.name: M-ARM-PATH-FLAT
arms.note: a dotted type path stops becoming a directory path, so every arm resolves to a file that does not exist and the addressability gate can check nothing

arms.name: M-ARM-KIND-UNSPELLED
arms.note: an arm's address never spells its kind, so a cut aimed at a grammar declaration asks for FnMember and the addressability gate reaches nothing

arms.name: M-FIXTURE-CACHE-CWD-WRITE
arms.note: a compile writing into the fixture it shares with the compiles beside it is recorded, and its replay overwrites the lines a concurrent writer appended

arms.name: M-FIXTURE-CACHE-LOOKUP-NEVER-SERVES
arms.find: stored == null ? null : serve(stored, entry, compile, dir, tally, env);
arms.note: a lookup answers nothing for a compile it has recorded, so every hit is spawned through the shim

arms.name: M-FIXTURE-CACHE-LOOKUP-IGNORES-REQUEST-ENV
arms.note: the variables a job sets over the environment are not read, so a lookup answers an entry that ran the live arm's switch, and keys by this process's compiler variables
